title: [main] bug 639499 - fix: Remove Status = Released condition from Send action buttons on Cash Document page
summary: The 'Release and Send' and 'Post and Send' actions on the Cash Document page are now enabled for all Receipt documents, not just those with Released status.
key_points: Removed Status = Released condition from action button enable logic
Actions now available for Receipt documents regardless of status
Enables earlier sending in document workflow
quote: Both actions are now enabled whenever the document type is Receipt, regardless of its status.
